40020270.author: पदार्थः
40020270.content: सुमाली Sumali, वरलब्धान् those who had obtained boons, तु indeed, ज्ञात्वा having known, च and, एतान् these, निशाचरान् night-wanderers, उदतिष्ठत् rose up, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, सानुगः with his followers, सः he, रसातलात् from Rasatala

40020270.author: Translation
40020270.content: Sumali, having learned that these night-wanderers had obtained boons, rose up from Rasatala with his followers, abandoning all fear.

40020271.author: पदार्थः
40020271.content: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, महोदरः Mahodara, उदतिष्ठन् rose up, सुसंरब्धाः greatly excited, सचिवाः ministers, तस्य his, रक्षसः of the Rakshasa

40020271.author: Translation
40020271.content: Maricha, Prahasta, Virupaksha, and Mahodara, who were the greatly excited ministers of that Rakshasa (Sumali), also rose up.

40020272.author: पदार्थः
40020272.content: सुमाली Sumali, सचिवैः with ministers, सार्धम् together, वृतः surrounded, राक्षसपुङ्गवैः by chief Rakshasas, अभिगम्य having approached, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke

40020272.author: Translation
40020272.content: Sumali, surrounded by his ministers and other chief Rakshasas, approached Dashagriva, embraced him, and spoke these words.

40020273.author: पदार्थः
40020273.content: दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते to you, वत्स O son, सम्प्राप्तः achieved, चिन्तितः thought of, अयम् this, मनोरथः desire, यत् that, त्वम् you, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठात् from the best of the three worlds, लब्धवान् have obtained, वरम् boon, उत्तमम् excellent

40020273.author: Translation
40020273.content: Fortunately, O son, this cherished desire of yours has been achieved, as you have obtained an excellent boon from the best of the three worlds (Brahma).

40020274.author: पदार्थः
40020274.content: यत्कृते for whom, च and, वयम् we, लङ्काम् Lanka, त्यकत्वा having abandoned, याताः went, रसातलम् to Rasatala, तत् that, गतम् gone, नः our, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महत् great, विष्णुकृतम् caused by Vishnu, भयम् fear.

40020274.author: Translation
40020274.content: O mighty-armed one, the great fear caused by Vishnu, for which we abandoned Lanka and went to Rasatala, has now departed from us.

40020275.author: पदार्थः
40020275.content: असकृत् repeatedly, तद्भयात् from that fear, भीताः frightened, परित्यज्य having abandoned, स्वम् our own, आलयम् abode, विद्रुताः fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, प्रविष्टाः entered, स्म (past tense indicator), रसातलम् Rasatala.

40020275.author: Translation
40020275.content: Frightened repeatedly by that fear, all of us together abandoned our own abode and fled, entering Rasatala.

40020276.author: पदार्थः
40020276.content: अस्मदीया ours, च and, लङ्का Lanka, इयम् this, नगरी city, राक्षसोचिता suitable for Rakshasas, निवेशिता established, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, धनाध्यक्षेण by the lord of wealth, धीमता by the intelligent one.

40020276.author: Translation
40020276.content: This city of Lanka, suitable for Rakshasas, was established by your intelligent brother, the lord of wealth (Kubera), and belongs to us.

40020277.author: पदार्थः
40020277.content: यदि if, न not, अत्र here, शक्यम् possible, स्यात् it would be, साम्ना by conciliation, दानेन by giving, वा or, अनघ O sinless one, तरसा by force, वा or, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रत्यानेतुम् to bring back, कृतम् done, भवेत् it would be.

40020277.author: Translation
40020277.content: O sinless and mighty-armed one, if it is not possible to bring it back by conciliation or by gifts, then it should be done by force.

40020278.author: पदार्थः
40020278.content: त्वम् you, तु indeed, लङ्केश्वरः lord of Lanka, तात O dear one, भविष्यसि will be, न no, संशयः doubt, त्वया by you, राक्षसवंशः the Rakshasa race, अयम् this, निमग्नः submerged, अपि even, समुद्धृतः uplifted, सर्वेषाम् of all, नः us, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यसि will be, महाबल O mighty one.

40020278.author: Translation
40020278.content: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.

40020279.author: पदार्थः
40020279.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, मातामहम् to his maternal grandfather, उपस्थितम् who was present, वित्तेशः Kubera (the lord of wealth), गुरुः preceptor, अस्माकम् our, न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing).

40020279.author: Translation
40020279.content: Then Ravana spoke to his maternal grandfather, who was present, saying, "Kubera, the lord of wealth, is our preceptor; you ought not to speak such things."

40020280.author: पदार्थः
40020280.content: साम्ना even with gentle words, अपि also, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of Rakshasas, गरीयसा who was superior, प्रत्याख्यातः rejected, किञ्चित् anything, न not, आह said, तदा then, रक्षः the Rakshasa (grandfather), ज्ञात्वा having known, तस्य his (Ravana's), चिकीर्षितम् intention.

40020280.author: Translation
40020280.content: Even though the venerable maternal grandfather was rejected by the superior lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) with gentle words, the Rakshasa (grandfather) then said nothing, understanding Ravana's intention.

40020281.author: पदार्थः
40020281.content: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, वसन्तम् residing, रावणम् to Ravana, ततः then, उक्तवन्तम् who had spoken, तथा such, वाक्यम् words, दशग्रीवम् to Ravana, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Prahasta).

40020281.author: Translation
40020281.content: Then, after some time, while Ravana was residing there, the night-wanderer (Prahasta) addressed Ravana, who had spoken such words.

40020282.author: पदार्थः
40020282.content: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, प्रश्रितम् humble, वाक्यम् words, इदम् these, आह said, सः he, कारणम् with reason.

40020282.author: Translation
40020282.content: Prahasta then spoke these humble and reasonable words.

40020283.author: पदार्थः
40020283.content: दशग्रीव O Ravana, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, अर्हसि you ought, त्वम् you, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing), सौभ्रात्रम् brotherhood, न not, अस्ति exists, शूराणाम् among heroes, शृणु listen, च and, इदम् this, वचः word, मम my.

40020283.author: Translation
40020283.content: O mighty-armed Ravana, you ought not to speak such things, for brotherhood does not exist among heroes; therefore, listen to my words.

40020284.author: पदार्थः
40020284.content: अदितिश्च Aditi and, दितिश्चैव Diti also, भगिन्यौ two sisters, सहिते together, हि indeed, ते they, भार्ये wives, परमरूपिण्यौ of supreme beauty, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati.

40020284.author: Translation
40020284.content: Aditi and Diti, two sisters of supreme beauty, were indeed the wives of Prajapati Kashyapa.

40020285.author: पदार्थः
40020285.content: अदितिः Aditi, जनयामास gave birth to, देवान् gods, त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् lords of the three worlds, दितिः Diti, तु but, अजनयत् gave birth to, पुत्रान् sons, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, आत्मसम्भवान् born from himself.

40020285.author: Translation
40020285.content: Aditi gave birth to the gods, who became the lords of the three worlds, while Diti bore sons who were also born from Kashyapa.

40020286.author: पदार्थः
40020286.content: दैत्यानां of the Daityas, किल indeed, धर्मज्ञ O knower of Dharma, पुरी realm, इयं this, सवनार्णवा with forests and oceans, सपर्वता with mountains, मही earth, वीर O hero, ते they, अभवन् became, प्रभविष्णवः powerful.

40020286.author: Translation
40020286.content: O knower of Dharma and O hero, this entire earth, with its forests, oceans, and mountains, was indeed the realm of the powerful Daityas.

40020287.author: पदार्थः
40020287.content: निहत्य having killed, तान् them, तु but, समरे in battle, विष्णुना by Vishnu, प्रभविष्णुना the powerful, देवानां of the gods, वशम् under control, आनीतम् brought, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable.

40020287.author: Translation
40020287.content: However, the powerful Vishnu, having slain them in battle, brought this imperishable three worlds under the control of the gods.

40020288.author: पदार्थः
40020288.content: न not, एतत् this, एकः alone, भवान् you, एव only, करिष्यति will do, विपर्ययम् reversal, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, आचरितम् practiced, तत् that, कुरुष्व do, वचः word, मम my.

40020288.author: Translation
40020288.content: You alone will not be able to reverse this established order, which has been practiced by both gods and asuras, so please heed my advice.

40020289.author: पदार्थः
40020289.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहृष्टेन delighted, अन्तरात्मना by his inner self, चिन्तयित्वा having thought, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, वै indeed, बाढम् very well, इति thus, एव only, सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020289.author: Translation
40020289.content: Thus addressed, Ravana, with his inner self delighted, thought for a moment and then said, "Very well."

40020290.author: पदार्थः
40020290.content: सः he, तु indeed, तेन by that, एव only, हर्षेण by joy, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, वीर्यवान् powerful, वनम् to the forest, गतः went, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सह with, तैः those, क्षणदाचरैः night-wanderers.

40020290.author: Translation
40020290.content: Indeed, on that very day, the powerful Ravana, filled with that joy, went to the forest with those night-wanderers.

40020291.author: पदार्थः
40020291.content: त्रिकूटस्थः situated on Trikuta mountain, सः he, तु indeed, तदा then, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, प्रेषयामास sent, दौत्येन as an envoy, प्रहस्तम् Prahasta, वाक्यकोविदम् skilled in speech.

40020291.author: Translation
40020291.content: Then, Ravana, the night-wanderer, who was situated on Trikuta mountain, sent Prahasta, who was skilled in speech, as an envoy.

40020292.author: पदार्थः
40020292.content: प्रहस्त O Prahasta, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, त्वम् you, ब्रूहि tell, नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् to the chief of the Rakshasas, वचसा with the word, मम my, वित्तेशम् to the lord of wealth, सामपूर्वम् preceded by conciliation, इदम् this, वचः word.

40020292.author: Translation
40020292.content: "O Prahasta, go quickly and tell the lord of wealth, the chief of the Rakshasas, these conciliatory words from me."

40020293.author: पदार्थः
40020293.content: इयम् this, लङ्का Lanka, पुरी city, राजन् O King, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, महात्मनाम् great-souled, त्वया by you, निवेशिता established, सौम्य O gentle one, न not, एतत् this, युक्तम् proper, तव for you, अनघ O sinless one.

40020293.author: Translation
40020293.content: "O King, O gentle one, O sinless one, this city of Lanka, belonging to the great-souled Rakshasas, was established by you, but this is not proper for you."

40020294.author: पदार्थः
40020294.content: तत् therefore, भवान् you, यदि if, नः to us, हि indeed, अद्य today, दद्यात् would give, अतुलविक्रम O unequalled in valor, कृता done, भवेत् would be, मम my, प्रीतिः satisfaction, धर्मः duty, च and, एव indeed, अनुपालितः fulfilled.

40020294.author: Translation
40020294.content: O unequalled in valor, if you would indeed give it to us today, my satisfaction would be complete, and my duty would also be fulfilled.

40020295.author: पदार्थः
40020295.content: सः he, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, पुरीम् to the city, लङ्काम् Lanka, धनदेन by Kubera, सुरक्षिताम् well-protected, अब्रवीत् spoke, परमोदारम् to the most generous, वित्तपालम् lord of wealth, इदम् this, वचः word.

40020295.author: Translation
40020295.content: Having arrived at the city of Lanka, which was well-protected by Kubera, the messenger then spoke these words to the most generous lord of wealth.

40020296.author: पदार्थः
40020296.content: प्रेषितः sent, अहम् I, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, सुव्रत O one of good vows, त्वत्समीपम् to your presence, महाबाहो O mighty-armed, सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् among all weapon-bearers, वर O best.

40020296.author: Translation
40020296.content: O one of good vows, O mighty-armed, O best among all weapon-bearers, I have been sent to your presence by your brother, Dashagriva.

40020297.author: पदार्थः
40020297.content: तत् that, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, महाप्राज्ञ O greatly wise one, सर्वशास्त्रविशारद O expert in all scriptures, वचनम् message, मम my, वित्तेश O lord of wealth, यत् which, ब्रवीति says, दशाननः Dashanana.

40020297.author: Translation
40020297.content: O greatly wise one, O expert in all scriptures, O lord of wealth, please listen to my message, which Dashanana (Ravana) conveys.

40020298.author: पदार्थः
40020298.content: इयम् this, किल indeed, पुरी city, रम्य beautiful, सुमालिप्रमुखैः by Sumali and others, पुरा formerly, भुक्तपूर्वा previously enjoyed, विशालाक्ष O wide-eyed one, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valor.

40020298.author: Translation
40020298.content: O wide-eyed one, this beautiful city was indeed formerly inhabited by Rakshasas of terrible valor, led by Sumali and others.

40020299.author: पदार्थः
40020299.content: तेन by him, विज्ञाप्यते is being requested, सः he, अयम् this, साम्प्रतम् now, विश्रवात्मज O son of Vishrava, तत् therefore, एषा this (Lanka), दीयताम् let it be given, तात dear one, याचतः of him who is requesting, तस्य his, सामतः by peaceful means.

40020299.author: Translation
40020299.content: Prahasta requests Kubera, the son of Vishrava, to peacefully hand over Lanka to Ravana, who is now asking for it.

40020300.author: पदार्थः
40020300.content: प्रहस्तात् from Prahasta, अभिसंश्रुत्य having heard well, देवः the god, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, वचः the words, प्रत्युवाच replied, प्रहस्तम् to Prahasta, तम् him, वाक्यम् words, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech.

40020300.author: Translation
40020300.content: The god Vaishravana, who was skilled in speech, having heard Prahasta's words, replied to him.

40020301.author: पदार्थः
40020301.content: दत्ता given, मम to me, इयम् this, पित्रा by father, तु indeed, लङ्का Lanka, शून्या empty, निशाचरैः of night-wanderers, निवासिते settled, च and, मे by me, यक्षैः by Yakshas, दानमानादिभिः by gifts, honors, etc., गुणैः by means.

40020301.author: Translation
40020301.content: Kubera stated that his father had given him this Lanka, which was empty of Rakshasas, and he had settled it with Yakshas through various means like gifts and honors.

40020302.author: पदार्थः
40020302.content: ब्रूहि tell, गच्छ go, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, पुरम् the city, राज्यम् the kingdom, च and, यत् which, मम is mine, तव yours, अपि also, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, राज्यम् the kingdom, अकण्टकम् unhindered.

40020302.author: Translation
40020302.content: Kubera instructed Prahasta to go and tell Ravana that the city and kingdom which were his, were now also Ravana's, and he should enjoy this unhindered kingdom, O mighty-armed one.

40020303.author: पदार्थः
40020303.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, जगाम went, पितुः of his father, अन्तिकम् to the presence.

40020303.author: Translation
40020303.content: Having spoken thus, Kubera, the lord of wealth, went to his father's presence.

40020304.author: पदार्थः
40020304.content: अभिवाद्य having saluted, गुरुं the preceptor, प्राह he said, रावणस्य of Ravana, यदीप्सितम् what is desired, एष this, तात O father, दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, दूतं a messenger, प्रेषितवान्मम has sent to me.

40020304.author: Translation
40020304.content: Having saluted his father, Kubera informed him of Ravana's demand, saying, "O father, Dashagriva has sent a messenger to me with his desire."

40020305.author: पदार्थः
40020305.content: दीयतां let it be given, नगरी the city, लङ्का Lanka, पूर्वं formerly, रक्षोगणोषिता inhabited by Rakshasas, मयात्र by me here, यदनुष्ठेयं what is to be done, तन्ममाचक्ष्व that tell me, सुव्रत O one of good vows.

40020305.author: Translation
40020305.content: Kubera further stated, "Let the city of Lanka, formerly inhabited by Rakshasas, be given to him; please tell me, O revered one, what I should do in this situation."

40020306.author: पदार्थः
40020306.content: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो the Brahmarshi, thus addressed, असौ he, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, प्राञ्जलिं to the one with folded hands, धनदं to Kubera, प्राह said, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.

40020306.author: Translation
40020306.content: Thus addressed, the Brahmarshi Vishrava, the foremost among sages, spoke to Kubera, who stood with folded hands, saying, "Listen, O son, to my words."

40020307.author: पदार्थः
40020307.content: दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, उक्तवान्मम spoke to me, सन्निधौ in my presence, मया by me, निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद् he was rebuked, बहुशोक्तः much admonished, सुदुर्मतिः the evil-minded one.

40020307.author: Translation
40020307.content: Vishrava recounted that the mighty-armed, evil-minded Dashagriva had spoken to him in his presence, and he had repeatedly rebuked and admonished him.

40020308.author: पदार्थः
40020308.content: स he, क्रोधेन with anger, मया by me, चोक्तो was told, ध्वंसते he perishes, च and, पुनः पुनः again and again, श्रेयो welfare, अभियुक्तं connected with, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.

40020308.author: Translation
40020308.content: Vishrava continued, "Though I spoke to him with anger, warning him that he would repeatedly perish, now listen, O son, to my words which are conducive to your welfare and righteousness."

40020309.author: पदार्थः
40020309.content: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो bewildered by the granting of boons, मान्या those who are respectable, अमान्यान् those who are not respectable, सः he, दुर्मतिः evil-minded, न वेत्ति does not distinguish, मम my, शापात् from the curse, च and, प्रकृतिम् nature, दारुणाम् terrible, गतः attained.

40020309.author: Translation
40020309.content: Bewildered by the boons, that evil-minded one does not distinguish between the respectable and the disrespectful, and furthermore, he has attained a terrible nature due to my curse.

40020310.author: पदार्थः
40020310.content: तस्मात् therefore, गच्छ go, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, कैलासं to Kailasa, धरणीधरम् the mountain, निवेशय establish, निवासार्थं for residence, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, लङ्कां Lanka, सहानुगः with your followers.

40020310.author: Translation
40020310.content: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain Kailasa, abandon Lanka, and establish your residence there with your followers.

40020311.author: पदार्थः
40020311.content: तत्र there, मन्दाकिनी Mandakini, रम्या beautiful, नदीनाम् among rivers, उत्तमा best, नदी river, काञ्चनैः with golden, सूर्यसङ्काशैः resembling the sun, पङ्कजैः with lotuses, संवृतोदका whose waters are covered.

40020311.author: Translation
40020311.content: There flows the beautiful Mandakini river, the best among rivers, whose waters are covered with golden lotuses shining like the sun.

40020312.author: पदार्थः
40020312.content: कुमुदैः with white water lilies, उत्पलैः with blue lotuses, च and, एव also, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with other, च and, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant ones.

40020312.author: Translation
40020312.content: Its waters are also covered with white water lilies, blue lotuses, and other fragrant flowers.

40020313.author: पदार्थः
40020313.content: तत्र there, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, साप्सरः with Apsaras, उरग serpents, किंनराः Kinnaras, विहारशीलाः fond of sport, सततम् constantly, रमन्ते they delight, सर्वदा always, आश्रिताः residing.

40020313.author: Translation
40020313.content: Gods, along with Gandharvas, Apsaras, Uragas, and Kinnaras, constantly reside there, always delighting in recreation.

40020314.author: पदार्थः
40020314.content: न not, हि indeed, क्षमं proper, तव for you, अनेन with this, वैरं enmity, धनद O Kubera, रक्षसा demon, जानीषे you know, हि indeed, यथा how, अनेन by him, लब्धः obtained, परमको supreme, वरः boon

40020314.author: Translation
40020314.content: O Kubera, it is indeed not proper for you to have enmity with this demon, for you know well how he has obtained a supreme boon.

40020315.author: पदार्थः
40020315.content: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, गृहीत्वा having taken, आशु quickly, तद्वचः his words, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for his father, सदारपुत्रः with wife and sons, सामान्यः with his retinue, सवाहनधनो with vehicles and wealth, गतः went

40020315.author: Translation
40020315.content: Thus spoken to, Kubera, out of respect for his father, quickly accepted his words and departed with his wife, sons, retinue, vehicles, and wealth.

40020316.author: पदार्थः
40020316.content: प्रहस्तो Prahasta, अथ then, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, गत्वा having gone, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रहृष्टात्मा with a joyful heart, महात्मानं to the great-souled one, सहामात्यं with his ministers, सहानुजम् with his younger brothers

40020316.author: Translation
40020316.content: Then Prahasta, with a joyful heart, went to the great-souled Dashagriva, who was with his ministers and younger brothers, and spoke these words.

40020317.author: पदार्थः
40020317.content: शून्या empty, सा that, नगरी city, लङ्का Lanka, त्यक्त्त्वा having abandoned, एनां this, धनदो Kubera, गतः has gone, प्रविश्य having entered, तां that, सहास्माभिः with us, स्वधर्मं your own duty, प्रतिपालय govern

40020317.author: Translation
40020317.content: That city of Lanka is now empty, as Kubera has abandoned it and departed; therefore, enter that city with us and govern according to your own duty.

40020318.author: पदार्थः
40020318.content: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, महाबलः the mighty one, विवेश entered, नगरीं city, लङ्कां Lanka, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सबलानुगैः with his army and followers

40020318.author: Translation
40020318.content: Thus spoken to by Prahasta, the mighty Dashagriva entered the city of Lanka with his brothers, army, and followers.

40020319.author: पदार्थः
40020319.content: धनदेन by Kubera, परित्यक्ताम् abandoned, सुविभक्तमहापथाम् having well-divided great roads, आरुरोह ascended, सः he, देवारिः the enemy of gods, स्वर्गम् to the heaven-like city, देवाधिपः the lord of gods, यथा just as.

40020319.author: Translation
40020319.content: Ravana, the enemy of the gods, ascended to that city (Lanka), which had well-divided great roads and had been abandoned by Kubera, just as Indra ascends to heaven.

40020320.author: पदार्थः
40020320.content: सः he, च and, अभिषिक्तः having been crowned, क्षणदाचरैः by the night-wanderers, तदा then, निवेशयामास populated, पुरीम् the city, दशाननः Ravana, निकामपूर्णा completely filled, च and, बभूव became, सा that, पुरी city, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, नीलबलाहकोपमैः resembling dark clouds.

40020320.author: Translation
40020320.content: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.

40020321.author: पदार्थः
40020321.content: धनेश्वरः Kubera, तु but, अथ then, पितृवाक्यगौरवात् out of respect for his father's words, न्यवेशयत् established, शशिविमले on the moon-bright, गिरौ mountain, पुरीम् a city, स्वलङ्कृतैः well-decorated, भवनवरैः with excellent mansions, विभूषिताम् adorned, पुरन्दरस्य of Indra, इव like, तदा then, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.

40020321.author: Translation
40020321.content: But then Kubera, out of respect for his father's words, established a city on the moon-bright mountain (Kailasa), adorned with well-decorated excellent mansions, just like Indra's Amaravati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशः सर्गः ।। 11 ।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
